ACTIVE_EVENT_LIMIT_REACHED: You're running as many rolls as the free plan allows. One frees up when a roll closes or you cut one.
EVENT_GALLERY_CLOSED: This roll has closed. No one can join or add photos anymore.
EVENT_GALLERY_NOT_OPEN: This roll hasn't opened yet. Photos can be added from its date.
EVENT_MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED: This roll is full. Ask the host to make room.
EVENT_SCHEDULE_LOCKED: The date and film can only change before the roll opens.
EVENT_STILL_ACTIVE: Cut the roll, or wait for it to close, before deleting it.
EVENT_STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: There isn't enough room left on this roll for these photos.
